blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Simon Fraser Hills. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Simon Fraser Hills, Burnaby: 11 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 15 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Simon Fraser Hills rose from 10 in June to 11 in October (+10.0%), and 9 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.8% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condos and townhomes listed.

blocks.text: Simon Fraser Hills home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 townhomes sold in Simon Fraser Hills with a median price of $780,000 (the middle half sold between $720,000 and $922,500), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $551 per square foot, a median year built of 1972 and a median strata fee of $412 a month. 4 condos sold in Simon Fraser Hills, too few (5 needed) to give a typical price.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Simon Fraser Hills?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 condos and townhomes listed in Simon Fraser Hills. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Simon Fraser Hills a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Simon Fraser Hills had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Simon Fraser Hills from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 9 condos and townhomes sold in Simon Fraser Hills over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Simon Fraser Hills sell for?
faq.a: 11 townhomes sold in Simon Fraser Hills between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $780,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Simon Fraser Hills?
faq.a: The median was 27 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
